rules.name: CVE-2026-72530 — Server Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-72530: TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.. Product: Server
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-72530" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-72530" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-72530" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-REMOTE-CODE-EXECUTION-003

rules.name: CVE-2025-62593 — Ray Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2025-62593: Ray-Project Ray contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow remote code execution. Developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed to this vulnerability exploitable through Firefox and Safari.. Product: Ray
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2025-62593" or RuleName has "CVE-2025-62593" or ProcessName has "CVE-2025-62593" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-REMOTE-CODE-EXECUTION-010

rules.name: CVE-2026-63077 — TeamCity Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-63077: JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.. Product: TeamCity
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "CVE-2026-63077" or Message contains "TEAMCITY" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), clientIp_s | where count_ > 3

rules.name: CVE-2026-85706 — Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Exploitation

Product: Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 and (Process == "powershell.exe" or Process == "cmd.exe") and (CommandLine contains "-enc" or CommandLine contains "base64") | summarize count() by Computer, Process, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
